items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: But he had a helluva saxophone player, Harry Pettiford -- he was a helluva tenor man, you know.

ctx.x: He didn't want any two-trumpet group, in other words.

No, he didn't want me to play trumpet. I could out-play him playing trumpet, so he said, 'You play the saxophone.' But he had a helluva saxophone player, Harry Pettiford -- he was a helluva tenor man, you know.
